# Fuzzy Domain Kriging examples

Checking the behaviour of the legacy Excel spreadsheets and to confirm what they did.

# From /legacy/2012/soft_boundary.xls (sheet: test2)

```{r}
gauss_cov <- function(nugget, sill, range) {
  function(h) {
    if (range == 0) {
      return(nugget + sill)
    }
    e <- exp((-3*h/range))
    gaus <- nugget + sill*e
    return(gaus)
  }
}

x_samples <- c(61,64,63,68,71,73,75,65)
y_samples <- c(139,129,140,128,140,141,128,137)
v_samples <- c(477,227,696,646,606,791,783,559)

cov_func_A <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 10)
cov_func_AB <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 3)
cov_func_B <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 10)

soft <- 10/3
n <- length(x_samples) - 1

# Compute standard Euclidean spatial distances (N x N)
dx <- outer(x_samples, x_samples, "-")
dy <- outer(y_samples, y_samples, "-")
H <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

# In-Out matrix
A <- outer(c(1,1,0,0,0,0,0), c(1,1,0,0,0,0,0))
B <- outer(c(0,0,1,1,1,1,1), c(0,0,1,1,1,1,1))
AB <- 1-A-B

# Base Spatial Covariance Matrix (K)
K_A <- A * cov_func_A(H[1:n,1:n])^soft
K_B <- B * cov_func_B(H[1:n,1:n])
K_AB <- AB * cov_func_AB(H[1:n,1:n])
K_base <- K_A + K_AB + K_B

K_sys <- cbind(K_base, 1)
K_sys <- rbind(K_sys, c(rep(1, n), 0))

# Right-Hand Side Vector k (scaled by u_target)
h_target <- sqrt((x_samples[1:n] - x_samples[n+1])^2 + (y_samples[1:n] - y_samples[n+1])^2)
k_base <- c(cov_func_A(h_target[1:2]), cov_func_A(h_target[3:n]))
k_sys <- c(k_base, 1)

# Solve for Kriging Weights
w_augmented <- solve(K_sys, k_sys)
w <- w_augmented[1:n]

# Compute Estimate
estimate <- sum(w * v_samples[1:n])

cat("Estimate:", round(estimate, 3), "\n")
```

# From /legacy/2012/soft_boundary.xls (sheet: test3)

```{r}
gauss_cov <- function(nugget, sill, range) {
  function(h) {
    if (range == 0) {
      return(nugget + sill)
    }
    e <- exp((-3*h/range))
    gaus <- nugget + sill*e
    return(gaus)
  }
}

x_samples <- c(61,63,64,68,71,73,75,65)
y_samples <- c(139,140,129,128,140,141,128,137)
v_samples <- c(477,696,227,646,606,791,783,559)
mu <- c(1,1,1,1,1,0,0,0)

cov_func <- gauss_cov(5, 5, 10)

n <- length(x_samples) - 1

# Compute standard Euclidean spatial distances (N x N)
dx <- outer(x_samples, x_samples, "-")
dy <- outer(y_samples, y_samples, "-")
H <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

# Base Spatial Covariance Matrix (K)
K_base <- cov_func(H[1:n,1:n])
K_u <- outer(1-mu, mu)
diag(K_u) <- 1-mu

K_sys <- cbind(K_base, 1)
K_sys <- rbind(K_sys, c(rep(1, n), 0))
K_inv <- solve(K_sys)

KK <- -K_inv
diag(KK) <- 0
kk <- as.numeric(KK[1:n,1:n] %*% (1-mu[1:n]))
for (i in 1:n+1) {
  KK[i,1:n] <- -K_inv[i,1:n]/kk
}
KK[,n+1] <- 0
diag(KK) <- 1
K_D <- K_u * KK
K_inv <- K_D %*% K_inv

# Right-Hand Side Vector k
h_target <- sqrt((x_samples[1:n] - x_samples[n+1])^2 + (y_samples[1:n] - y_samples[n+1])^2)
k_base <- cov_func(h_target)
k_sys <- c(k_base, 1)

# Solve for Kriging Weights
w_augmented <- K_inv %*% k_sys
w <- w_augmented[1:n]

# Compute Estimate
estimate <- sum(w * v_samples[1:n])

cat("Estimate:", round(estimate, 3), "\n")
```

# From /legacy/2012/soft_boundary.xls (sheet: test4)

```{r}
gauss_cov <- function(nugget, sill, range) {
  function(h) {
    if (range == 0) {
      return(nugget + sill)
    }
    e <- exp((-3*h/range))
    gaus <- nugget + sill*e
    return(gaus)
  }
}

x_samples <- c(61,63,64,68,71,73,75,65)
y_samples <- c(139,140,129,128,140,141,128,137)
v_samples <- c(477,696,227,646,606,791,783,559)
mu <- c(1,1,1,1,1,0,0,0)

cov_func_A <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 10)
cov_func_AB <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 1)
cov_func_B <- gauss_cov(0, 10, 10)
soft <- 10

n <- length(x_samples) - 1

# Compute standard Euclidean spatial distances (N x N)
dx <- outer(x_samples, x_samples, "-")
dy <- outer(y_samples, y_samples, "-")
H <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

# Right-Hand Side Vector k
h_target <- sqrt((x_samples[1:n] - x_samples[n+1])^2 + (y_samples[1:n] - y_samples[n+1])^2)
k_base <- cov_func_A(h_target)

# A
K_A <- cov_func_A(H[c(1,3),c(1,3)])
K_A <- cbind(K_A, 1)
K_A <- rbind(K_A, c(1,1,0))
k_A <- c(k_base[c(1,3)])
k_A <- c(k_A, 1)
w_A <- solve(K_A, k_A)
e_A <- sum(v_samples[c(1,3)] * w_A[1:2])

# B
K_B <- cov_func_B(H[c(2,4:7),c(2,4:7)])
K_B <- cbind(K_B, 1)
K_B <- rbind(K_B, c(rep(1,5),0))
k_B <- c(k_base[c(2,4:7)])
k_B <- c(k_B, 1)
w_B <- solve(K_B, k_B)
e_B <- sum(v_samples[c(2,4:7)] * w_B[1:5])
```
